The most material change is a short-interval improvement in the Top-100 breadth proxy alongside persistent ETH/BTC strength, set against weaker 12-hour returns and negative aggressive quote flow. Horizon disagreement is substantial: 24-hour returns are slightly positive while 12-hour returns are negative, and 72-hour ETH/BTC strength does not resolve that conflict. The broader rotation context also differs by lookback and provider. This is more consistent with an unresolved pause or mixed transition than confirmed re-acceleration or late-cycle deterioration. Healthy continuation remains possible; so does later deterioration if weakness in breadth, leadership, or liquidity becomes persistent. Neither early-exit risk nor late-exit risk is resolved by these observations. The shadow protection-calibration report has no eligible matured rows and provides no exit, pullback, or re-entry rule. This interpretation is descriptive and noncanonical.
